description: Záplavová území významných vodních toků is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Středočeský kraj. These are spatial data (shapefile) related to floodplains. Coverage: Středočeský kraj. The portal shows the English title as "Floodplains of major watercourses" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Středočeský kraj. Its keywords include záplavová území, záplavové území. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70891095/1739251932/distribuce/a96977781ac5a0fcb730afd7c032feb4/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
